channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Chipotle: Free Chips and Guac with Entree - Code AVO2026
item.guid: Chipotle-Free Chips and Guac with Entree - Code A-2026-07-30
item.description: Use code AVO2026 at checkout on the Chipotle app or Chipotle.com with any full-priced entree purchase to get free chips and guac for National Avocado Day — no account required beyond the app. (Through August 1, 2026)

item.title: Qdoba: National Avocado Day BOGO Free Entree
item.guid: Qdoba-National Avocado Day BOGO Free Entree-2026-07-30
item.description: Buy one full-sized entree and a drink, get a second entree of equal or lesser value free — automatically added to your Qdoba Rewards Wallet starting July 31; quesadillas excluded. (Through August 1, 2026)

item.title: Del Taco: BOGO Epic Fresh Guac Burritos
item.guid: Del Taco-BOGO Epic Fresh Guac Burritos-2026-07-30
item.description: Buy one Epic Fresh Guac Burrito and get a second one free at Del Taco through August 2 — no app required, available in-restaurant. (Through August 2, 2026)

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu
item.description: Choose from 3-piece Signature Chicken, 3 Chicken Tenders, a Chicken Sandwich, or Two Regular Sides for just $5 each — no app needed, available at all locations. (Through August 31, 2026)

item.title: Wendy's: $1 Small Classic Frosty
item.description: Get a small Classic Chocolate or Vanilla Frosty for just $1 when you order online, in the app, at the drive-thru, or in-store — delivery excluded. (Through August 23, 2026)

item.title: Burger King: $5 Your Way Meal
item.description: Build a meal with a sandwich, side, and drink for $5 every day via the BK app — a reliable everyday value with no minimum spend tricks. (Ongoing)

item.title: KFC: 5 Chicken Tenders for $5 (App)
item.description: Get five chicken tenders for $5 when you order through the KFC app — a straightforward digital deal with no purchase minimum. (Limited time)

item.title: Shake Shack: Any Custard for $3 with Code CUSTARDTIME
item.guid: Shake Shack-Any Custard for $3 with Code CUSTARDTIME-2026-07-30
item.description: Use code CUSTARDTIME at checkout on the Shake Shack app, website, or in-restaurant kiosk to get any custard for $3 — National Ice Cream Day promo extended through mid-August. (Through August 19, 2026)

item.title: Denny's: Slammin' Meal Deals from $5.99
item.description: Denny's Slammin' Meal Deals offer full breakfast and dinner combos starting at $5.99 all day, every day — perfect for late-night diners at this 24-hour chain. (Ongoing)

item.title: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Sweetgreen: Alice Waters' Peach & Goat Cheese Salad
item.description: Limited-edition summer collab with chef Alice Waters - a seasonal peach & goat cheese salad available nationwide in-app and in stores, with 1% of proceeds donated to the Edible Schoolyard Project. (Through August 10, 2026)
